note: v57.16 — Screener factors use completed sessions only (P1442).

p.title: Screener factors use completed sessions only
p.symptom: Factors labelled "세션 종가 기준" were built from a refresh 22 minutes after the US open: the last daily bar was the in-progress session, feeding returns, volume, ranges and VCP (e.g. NVDA factorBarStart 2026-10-01T13:30Z, computed 13:52Z).
p.root_cause: _enrichPriceFactors used every bar Yahoo returned; the isSessionComplete guard existed only on the breadth path.
p.fix: fetch-data _enrichPriceFactors filters each history to bars whose session has closed (isSessionComplete, KR 15:45 KST / US 16:15 ET) before any factor, VCP or setup field is computed; rows carry factorBarCompleteness=completed-sessions-only and partialSessionDropped when a bar was removed.
p.violated_rule: Review 2026-10-04 (institutional standard): what a number is called must match how it was computed — completed sessions, one model for ranking and validation, one currency and denominator, named definitions.
p.prevention: ci-data-pipeline-contract-check (factor fixtures) and the next refresh-screener run.
p.verification: Source review; the next screener refresh publishes the completeness fields.

changelog: **완료 종가만으로 팩터 계산 (P1442):** 장 시작 직후 갱신이 진행 중인 오늘 봉을 넣어 계산하던 문제를 고쳐, 모든 팩터·VCP가 마감된 세션만 씁니다.
